notes.title: v0.2.1: Set 7, Legendary Geckos, QoL and Bugfixes!
notes.content: [h1]v0.2.1 is finally here![/h1][h2]Bringing some important QoL updates and bugfixes![/h2][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374738/0943a25203e46c6b9edb86e50d5614635794e65b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Set #7[/b] just came out, including [b]2 new boxes[/b] and [b]19 new geckos[/b], some with unique effects![/p][p]The Collection App also got expanded, now showing all 8 legendary geckos you can collect through various tasks.[/p][p]I will post clues on how to obtain all legendary geckos form time to time on Steam and Discord, so stay tuned ;)[/p][p][/p][p]I've also been able to boost performance when having alot of geckos, expect more performance updates soon. [/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][u][b]And also, i've made the game 33% cheaper for the whole Early access![/b][/u][/p][p]Not sure if the price will go up again after the full release, but it might depending on the amount of Content that ill add until then.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374738/d240872ae5f330609e52bca37b611fdcf743dc8b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]New Content:[/h3][list][*][p]Set 7 Box (lvl 71) + Shiny Box (lvl 75)[/p][/*][*][p]10 Common, 3 Rare, 3 Super and 3 Gold Geckos from Set 7[/p][/*][*][p]7 New Legendary Geckos, with different tasks to obtain them[/p][/*][*][p]Small additions to Gecko Behaviour Tables[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]QoL and Bugfixes:[/h3][list][*][p]Nights aren't as dark anymore as before[/p][/*][*][p]Added "P" hotkey to quick save[/p][/*][*][p]Visual Clue around placed Furniture to see where you can place stuff and where you can't[/p][/*][*][p]You can now close NPC Dialogues and several other UI popups with the Escape key[/p][/*][*][p]Huge Performance boost around lots of gecks[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Higher Shell spawning rate[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Night Shells not spawning[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Toggle / Hold Run setting not saving[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Audio Glitches when healing/shedding geckos[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed paying double for burgers[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Loading screen issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Delivery App still allowing to look around[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Delivery NPCs Collision (also known as "deliveries not working")[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Weather too cloudy, weird lighting[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed various Tank Deco bugs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Warning, Spoilers below...[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374738/d8164e634b4886d045d84456f8e07db4340ff561.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]First clue: Trash might not be as worthless as we thought..[/p][p][/p][p]See ya next time![/p]

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0b
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The [b]crashing issues[/b] are finally resolved, and other bugs too.
I've also added a [b]"Quality" setting[/b], to save performance on lower end machines.


- Fixed crashing when checkout full
- Fixed "set price" popup on the bottom of screen, when set to 4k resolution
- Fixed pallet type not resetting when empty
- Fixed flying pallets when purchasing stuff with auto pallet turned on
- Fixed visual glitches set 1 boxes
- Fixed paying double for gender reveals
- Fixed "autosave" in settings add translation
- Fixed shrinking shell model when using a museumbox
- Fixed some occlusion culling issues


Thanks for being patient with me!

notes.title: Patch v0.2.0a
notes.content:
First Patch for v0.2 is now live!

- Fixed Loud Sound at start (you can still hear the fountain, will be fixed in the next patch)
- Fixed NPC's walking into each other
- Fixed getting stuck on some UI elements
- Fixed some other stuff i don't remember


There will be another patch soon with the rest of the smaller bugs fixed, big thanks to the community for helping out finding bugs!

notes.title: The biggest update yet!
notes.content:
[h2]The New v0.2 Beta Is Live!
[/h2][p]This is the biggest update yet, and im happy its finally done!
[/p][list][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Multiplayer![/b] Invite or Join friends from the Steam Overlay (You'll have to be in the main menu to join others)[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Map Expansion![/b] Discover the City, find all new Chests and secrets. (Still work in progress, city will have a huge update before the full v0.2 release)[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Gecko Delivery![/b] Get Orders on your "Delivery App", and sell geckos around the map for better prices.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Gecko Breeding![/b] Gender your geckos at the vet, and breed them for a chance to get a baby gecko.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Corruption Dropper, 10 new Geckos![/b] Unlocked at level 100.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Prehistoric Dropper, 14 new Geckos![/b] Unlockable through donating all shells and artifacts to the museum.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Tank Decoration is back![/b] Press "F" while looking at any Tank to decorate it.[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Dynamic Weather![/b] (Not synced with your local time anymore)[/p][/*][*][p][b][i]NEW [/i]Shop is now expandable 2x the size![/b][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Complete Visual Overhaul[/b] (Shader, Sky, Water etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Much better performance[/b] (constantly over 60fps on a low end pc, with thousands of geckos)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Player Movement[/b] + Better Jump (Coyote Time)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Character Creator[/b] for Multiplayer[/p][/*][*][p]You can grab specific Geckos from any Tank, and see tags like sickness, gender etc.[/p][/*][*][p]Companions stay unlocked after purchasing them[/p][/*][*][p]Leveling up is much quicker, especially from Level 2-20 + Stuff gets unlocked earlier than before[/p][/*][*][p]A ton of other smaller additions and bugfixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There will be more [b]regular content updates[/b] from now on, just as before. Let us hear your feedback![/p]

notes.title: What i've been working on
notes.content:
Hey!

Sorry for being quiet the last few days, i'm [b]currently working on version v0.2[/b], a huge update that will change and add a ton of stuff.

I've had to remake pretty much the whole code of the game for the new features, that will come with GeckoShop v0.2.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374738/a82a4a894e26dcc84fca944ec3aba60524285909.png[/img]

Gather your friends for the next update, the shop’s too busy for one keeper alone.


Big shoutout to the best community, giving my best to make sure y'all will love this new update!

notes.title: Update v0.1.3 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374738/d4951d1014e8be1527c4ebb885b8722ac23216d4.png[/img]



Hi!

This is the biggest Update yet since the EA release, and there is still so much more to come!
Check out the Roadmap for more infos: https://trello.com/b/7O2IWuCE



[h2]Patchnotes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] NEW!    7x New Shop Decorations!
[*] NEW!    "Rack" Furniture! Store every type of item, build your own warehouse and keep stock of everything
[*] NEW!    "Picture Frame" Furniture! Show your favorite pictures! Put it on walls, or place it wherever you want
[*] Once you purchase a pet, it stays now unlocked
[*] TV links get saved now after reloading
[*] Better performance
[*] Customers choose now random checkouts, instead of a specific sequence
[*] Added an indicator for shop deco that attracts more customers
[*] UI rework, clean up
[*] "Hold Rightclick" interactions are faster now (moving, selling)
[*] Made so you can only get 1 restocker, to prevent dropping geckos and other bugs (if you already have more, feel free to dismiss them)
[*] Fixed "Standing Lamp" holo not changing color when placeable
[*] Fixed Game starting at UI scale = 0
[/list]



BTW im still working on the Tank Deco bug, got someone else to check the code with me.
I've deactivated the Tank Deco feature for now, since i'm fixing around 5-10 files daily and that takes alot of time that could be spend into fixing the actual bug.
Hope this will get resolved soon!

notes.title: Patch v0.1.2 is live!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45374738/486775dac6e843a3c929f70e4cb743050d6d2f93.png[/img]


Hey!


What a great start into Early Access, as expected some new bugs got found at launch, but could be quickly fixed. Very thankful for all of your support!

Some important settings were still missing like UI scale, toggle/hold run and some other stuff, and i was finally able to add them to the game. Custom controlls is still being worked on!


[h2]Latest Patchnotes from v0.1.2:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New "Friends" Dropper + 12 New Geckos! (You might recognize some gecks)
[*] Total rework of level up popups
[*] Fixed restocker throwing geckos out of the restock tank
[*] Fixed just one single gecko getting sick
[*] Fixed cleaners not picking up gecko boxes
[*] Fixed several other bugs
[*] Zodiac Dropper unlocks at level 77 now
[/list]



[h2]Patchnotes from v0.1.1:[/h2]

[list]
[*] added UI scale setting
[*] added run toggle / hold setting 
[*] mouse sensitivity saves now
[*] added additional tips to tutorial
[*] added ability to set TV's volume
[*] fixed audio volume only changing when opening settings
[*] fixed stolen items falling through floor sometimes when thief gets hit

1. Employees to reset their upgrade level
2. Tank deco to be bugged for some players

But im sure this will be also fixed in the next few days. much more is coming soon, new content and some big QOL updates!

notes.title: Alooot of exciting updates!
notes.content:
Hey!

Much happened in the last three weeks for GeckoShop, so many content updates released, and the game was never as polished as it is now.
The community's been growing daily, with many youtubers and streamers making content about GeckoShop. We are super thankful for all the support!


Join the [b][url=https://discord.gg/ZNKTfHPPCj]Discord[/url][/b] if you haven't already:
[url=https://discord.gg/ZNKTfHPPCj]https://discord.gg/ZNKTfHPPCj[/url]


[b]I will list up some highlists from the latest updates:[/b]

- Mac and Linux Support added
- 7 New Furnitures! Sofas (lvl 8), Lamps (lvl 9) and Rugs (lvl 11)
- New "Zodiac" Vending Machine, with 13 new super geckos!
- New Employee "Restocker"! Takes Geckos from Restock Furniture and stores them in the correct Tanks.
- x2 New Furnitures, "Restock Tank" and "Restock Basin". Geckos inside those furnitures will be stored by the Restockers.
- You can set a custom phone wallpaper (in settings, paste image path)
- New Beach + Ocean!
- Statues are back to the furniture shop (unlock at lvl 23)
- Setting to run the game in background
- Mouse sensitivity + Invert X and Y settings
- Game pauses now with escape key
- Cleaned up graphics / new shader
- Several map additions, and hidden areas
- Customers won't get stuck at checkouts anymore
- Fixed tanks not resetting the gecko type 
- Added a WIP visual grid that appears when placing or moving furniture
- Expanded Collection App with 3 categories + Zodiac Geckos
- Better lab odds (50% common>rare, 40% rare>super, 50% super>lab)
- You can now look completely up and down
- Decoration attracts more customers to your shop
- Gecko boxes open 0.6 seconds faster now
- Completely reworked Customers/NPC system (purchase item RNG, how they choose furniture etc.)
- New Pallet system, easier to add and take boxes from.
- Shop App now shows you the Box rarity odds if you hover over their "?" icon
- New Shiny Boxes for Set 1, 2 and 3 (11% common, 80% rare, 8.5% super, 0.5% gold)
- New Rarity + 11 new Geckos, "Golden" (0.01% chance from common boxes), has unique effects when opening boxes
- Added a second Museum Box at the new Beach.
- Added Trampolines, unlockable at level 40 (+ different Color varieties)
- You are now able to click on Cashiers to send them to another random Checkout
- Level needed to unlock Box 2 and 3 was lowered
- You now get notified when something got stolen from your shop
- Building and Moving Furniture snaps now to a grid for better alligning
- New Furniture "Catch Basin Big" (unlock at level 18)
- 4 New Shop Colors


I've also been actively working on content for the full release, and features like full controller support, multiple languages, steam achievements etc.


Everytime there's a new patch or update I post it on our [url=https://discord.gg/ZNKTfHPPCj]Discord[/url], so don't forget to join!

notes.title: Play the GeckoShop Demo now!
notes.content:
The Demo finally launched for 'GeckoShop'!

I was able to fix all the bugs we found in the Closed Beta, now I'm ready to publish the Demo for everyone to play.

If you still find a bug somewhere, or want to tell me your feedback (very appreciated!):
You'll find two buttons for this in the Main Menu of the Demo, this buttons will open a short google form where you can let me know.

notes.title: Announcement + Closed Beta
notes.content:
Hey fellows!

We are so happy to finally [b]announce our new game 'GeckoShop'![/b]

But before we go into Early Access, we'll need to clean everything up and polish the game as good as possible. And we need your help!

We are sending out Steam-Keys to people who want to get the game early and for free, to check if everything works as intended.

[url=https://discord.gg/4qzy5rPYEg]Join our Discord[/url], and react to the latest message in the [b]#updates[/b] channel to [b]get access to the Closed Beta![/b]

You can also find two forms for feedback and bug reports, we are actively checking them and fixing the game.


Stay cool, see ya on Discord!
